name: tplqueue-overview
description: Cross-repository TplQueue integration guidance for choosing packages, composing Core and Adapter, dependency injection, ASP.NET/SignalR, legacy .NET applications, DataJobs, payload handlers and cache providers.

interface.shortDescription: Start here for TplQueue packages and application integration.
interface.longDescription: Seven portable, instruction-only skills for adopting TplQueue across Core, Adapter, Abstractions, and Usage: architecture, package selection, direct composition, Microsoft DI, ASP.NET/SignalR, legacy .NET, and DataJob/cache/handler composition. Routes deeper questions to the owning plugins and keeps Core implementation private. This plugin is MIT; Core retains its own package/license terms.
defaultPrompt: Which TplQueue packages do I need for my application?
